partitions: independent decision cohort per candidate slot
controls.execution: sequential, rotated method order, same process and machine; no exogenous noise in these fixtures

controls.history: all methods persist all previous condition episodes; D queries compatible and E queries foreign-condition real records with the same eight-record cap, no extra target source; actual historical packets can differ with prior choices; original synthetic bad-prior test retained separately
controls.fairness: equal access opportunities and explicit candidate/adoption/actuation caps, not equal realized information or CPU quotas; fixed/trigger/no-history are policy ablations and E is a context-mismatch stress test; no strict universal fairness or superiority claim
controls.limitations: small supplied synthetic grammar; target instances reset each episode; B and F are identical in this protocol; no history-specific performance advantage is established; rankings can change workload
